messages:
maria: Dropping the new side-panel tweak mock — main goal: make filters usable when people have lots of facet groups and avoid feeling 'collapsed away'. Quick thoughts?

jake: Love the resize affordance. One nit: when panel is collapsed, the empty state reads 'No filters selected' which feels odd. Maybe suggest an action CTA instead.

sasha: Agreed. Also for keyboard users the collapse/expand toggle needs an accessible label. Proposal: aria-label="Toggle filter panel, use left/right arrows to resize".

ryan: +1 on CTA. Maybe: 'Show filters' and a small hint: 'Press F to toggle' — do we want a keyboard shortcut?

maria: I like a single-key toggle but worried about conflicts. Could surface the shortcut only in the empty state microcopy. Example copy: 'No filters applied. Press ? for shortcuts or click "Show filters"'

jake: On badges: performance badges currently show 'p95 latency' which is noisy in dense rows. Can we show a condensed icon + tooltip instead of three numbers?

sasha: Maybe show a colored dot + 'fast/ok/slow' text on hover. Keeps table density and still conveys perf quickly.

ryan: For version pinning: when you pin a model in the catalog, does that pin carry into compare view? Right now mock shows independent pins which is confusing.

maria: Good catch. My take: pin should be global for that model (persist across views) but compare should allow temporary local overrides (a little pin icon that says 'local override'). Will add microcopy to explain.

jake: Accessibility nit: focus trap when panel open — keyboard users can't reach compare table header. Need to ensure panel does not trap tab focus.

sasha: Also aria-live region for badge updates (quantization/latency changes) so screenreader users get notified when perf numbers refresh.

ui-bot: design-review: please add links to figma file + annotate hotspot for pin propagation.

maria: I'll update the mock and add the copy options. Action items:
- maria: update empty state copy + shortcut microcopy and aria-label snippet
- jake: prototype compact badge icon + tooltip
- sasha: write aria-live snippet and validate focus order
- ryan: check pinning persistence across routes and edge cases

maria: ETA: EOD tomorrow for first pass. Thanks all! :sparkles:
